varningar: A leak was found and fixed while checking the finished file. The end-card layer started at 36.4 s, but the white circle transition starts at 36.0 s and the Swedish product page was readable inside the circle for a few tenths of a second - store domain, 1 469,00 kr and 1 129,00 kr. Measured in the rendered file: white pixels 0.16 % at 36.0 s, 33.7 % at 36.3 s, 78 % at 36.4 s. The layer now starts at 36.0 s and the video was re-burned.

The eight US videos built on 2026-09-18 use the same 36.4 s timing and therefore carry the same leak. They are live and stay live - a live ad is never switched off after the fact. The recipe is fixed, so the next round that copies it starts correct.

The ad copy came back with two lines that failed the three-question test and were rewritten. The headline was an instruction any cover seller could run; it is now 'Bare taket - ingen hjelp trengs', which a full-vehicle cover cannot sign. The first paragraph now names the roof hatches and the seams instead of describing the problem in general terms.
